items.text: activate kar do
roaming chahiye
international on karo

items.context: Are you looking to activate national or international roaming?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Do you want to activate roaming for India or abroad?
items.text: international chahiye

items.context: When do you want the roaming service to start?
items.text: abhi chahiye
mera sim par international roaming activate karna hai
kya mujhe apne number se roaming activate karne ke liye documents chahiye
main office ke liye Dubai ja raha hoon roaming chahiye
please mujhe bolo kaise national roaming activate kar sakta hoon
mera plan mein international roaming included nahi hai activate karwana hai
kya international roaming activate karne ke baad extra charges lagenge
mera sim connection main account linked hai roaming activate kar do

items.context: Is this for international roaming or just within India?
items.text: ji haan international roaming activate karni hai

items.context: Where are you currently located and where will you be traveling?
items.text: main apna sim Delhi se leke abhi abroad ja raha hoon

items.context: Is this request for a prepaid or postpaid connection?
items.text: kya mujhe postpaid par bhi abhi roaming activate karna padega

items.context: For how long do you want the roaming to be active?
items.text: main chahun to kab tak ye roaming service valid rahegi

items.context: Is your account dues clear before activating roaming service?
items.text: mera last bill clear hai kya roaming service ke liye
mujhe international roaming activate karwana hai kyunki main agle hafte se Dubai me rahunga aur wahan phone use karna hai
mera sim number 9876543210 hai aur main India me hoon lekin kal se main abroad jara hoon toh ajeeb charge na lagen
kya aap mujhe bata sakte ho ki international roaming activate karne ke liye kya process hai aur kitna charge lagega main postpaid customer hoon

items.context: Your account is clear would you like to activate international roaming now and confirm the start date?
items.text: ji haan aapka account clear hai international roaming activate karni hai kya main start date confirm karu abhi

items.context: Do you want to activate national roaming or international roaming or both I can help you with that
items.text: aap national roaming activate karna chahte hain ya international dono options hai aapko batata hoon

items.context: Can you tell me if any specific documents are needed for international roaming or can it be activated online?
items.text: kya aap mujhe bata sakte ho ki international roaming ke liye koi specific documents chahiye ya online activate ho sakta hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: roaming - wants to activate international or national roaming
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
